handoff: Review approved: GR6 cleanup records unfinished units of a merged story done before the archive; pure decide, atomic write, S2 kept; tests at decide and runtime seams. 1 minor (older cleaned-up stories not repaired, deliberate).

findings.title: Stories cleaned up by an older norn are not repaired
findings.detail:
#88's observed stories (gh-60, gh-69, gh-76) keep their parked state.json and stay in the inbox: finishMerged runs only as part of a cleanup_merged_story, which is not decided again for a story already recorded done. The handoff states this deliberately.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: If wanted, a follow-up issue: treat a parked unit of a story whose base_status is done as finished in the inbox, or a one-off migration.
